worker.description: The worker to give another assignment.

prompt.description:
The assignment. It continues the worker's provider session, so it can
refer to earlier work.

timeout_secs.description: Time limit for this run in whole seconds, replacing the worker's.

outputSchema.title: StartResponse
outputSchema.description:
The answer to `start` and to `follow_up`.

A run that could not go ahead is finished at once: `state` is `finished`,
`outcome` is `refused` and `error` says why. `read` returns its result. A
refused `start` creates no worker, so `worker` is absent.

worker.description: The worker, absent when `start` was refused.

ahead.description:
Runs ahead of this one on its worker, counting the running one. Present
while queued.

oneOf.description: Waiting behind another run on its worker, or for a running slot.

Outcome.description: How a run ended. Every run ends in exactly one of these.

oneOf.description: The provider finished the assignment and returned a final answer.
The provider or delega hit an error; `error.kind` says which.
The caller stopped the run, or went away.

The run did not go ahead: invalid request, a limit, or a denied
permission that stopped it.

ErrorDetail.description: Why a run did not complete. Present unless the outcome is `completed`.

kind.description:
A short machine-readable label for the kind of error. Free text, so a
reader must tolerate values it does not know. The values used so far:
`invalid_request` (a refused run whose request failed validation),
`timed_out` and `interrupted` (set by the matching constructors).

provider_exit_code.description: The provider process exit code, when it exited with one.
